continuityReviewScope: Actual1.2/1.4/1.6/1.8/2.2/2.8/3.5s stages plus every frame in the1.2–2.4s transition. Pool counts and final clearing alone do not establish visual continuity.

persistentSealReviewScope: Actual post-impact.25/.65/1.2/1.6/2.2/2.8/3.5/4.3/4.62s native stages and meteorSeal.opacity series. Active/opacity alone does not establish visible carving retention.

actualCompiledBuildProfile.qualification: Read from the frozen served bundle. This task checks training-range VFX and actual casts, not campaign growth/balance acceptance. Concurrent profile flags are recorded as compiled and are never changed to force normal-rule claims.

artSourceEvidence.declaration: V37 deterministically adds a faint orange interior fill and adjusts texture translucency. The V35 cloud source/prompt are reused without generation. artSourceEvidence.processingThisRound: deterministic translucent orange fill and texture alpha adjustment

sealFadeTransitions.qualification: Pause intentionally hides and clears active VFX. Cached opacity is the actual last-draw surface property, not a visible paused seal or a newly simulated alpha. The authoritative clock stays frozen; active ground.inspect opacity resumes from that clock.

assetStabilityAtDelivery.qualification: Frozen served resource bytes are authoritative for the recording. Current source changes, if any, are reported separately and never relabel the served snapshot.

targetAlignment.qualification: This checks actual event/cue anchors. Native stage images must still establish visible rock, flame and seal alignment.

coolingContinuityEvidence.qualification: Review the actual native images and every transition. Active pool records, mesh counts and eventual clearing do not prove an unbroken visible fire surface.

ignitionPropagationEvidence.samplingQualification: Nearest real exported 30fps frame. Requested ages may share a frame; actual ages remain authoritative. No interpolated frames or timing changes.
ignitionPropagationEvidence.geometryQualification: Explicit supportWidth/supportDepth/footprintRadius describe the fixed carrier; width is a world-bounds measurement and is not substituted for support. Inspector constants alone do not prove visible ignition propagation or art acceptance.

persistentSealEvidence.qualification: Ground meteorSeal records and their actual opacity are checked independently of fire/impact records. Native images still establish visible carving clarity, rear completeness and gradual fading; inspector alpha alone is not art acceptance.

sameFrameColourEvidence.qualification: Each actual native frame contains the central flame and sigil. Compare the faint orange interior fill and visible ground through the more translucent sigil. Texture alpha is intentionally allowed to change; renderer draw opacity is separate. Only fixed cropping/uniform resizing is used, with no exact pixel-colour match claim.
